lane_declaration: Self-declared preregistered lane H77V following AGENTS.md, docs/PROJECT_PROMPT.md, and docs/review-2026-10-21-h77g.md (IR-H77G-01, IR-H77G-02, IR-H77G-03). Tests spectral mesh de-aliasing (sigma >= 36 px = 3.6 km) of rectilinear 3.5 km / 7.0 km MT/geodetic/seismic inversion grids, corrected across-valley tubular Hessian demagnetization troughs, antiparallel gravity-basement step concordance, road/mining-deconfounded 1 m LiDAR & 10 m 3DEP fluvial knickpoint-scarp interactions, 8-channel fold-visible SLOCO mechanics, and kernel-convolved Lagrangian-priced Dinkelbach submodular cover allocation.

hypotheses.name: Spectral Mesh-Dealiased Regional Crustal Regime Modulator (sigma = 36 px = 3.6 km)
hypotheses.mechanism: Eliminates the 35.02 px (3.5 km) and 70.04 px (7.0 km) rectilinear inversion mesh step artifacts discovered in IR-H77G-01 (where 23.5%-33.1% of adjacent pixel diffs are identically zero) via sigma=36 px Gaussian low-pass filtering before computing clay-cap margin gradients and transtensional strain-seismicity regime modulators.

hypotheses.name: Corrected Tubular Hydrothermal Demagnetization Trough x Scarp-Knickpoint Conduit
hypotheses.mechanism: Applies the IR-H77G-02 corrected across-valley Hessian eigenvalue (lambda_1(-H_RTP) > 0) weighted by linear tubularity across 150 m, 300 m, and 600 m scales, and couples multi-scale magnetite-destruction persistence with road/claim-deconfounded 1 m LiDAR / 10 m 3DEP scarps and fluvial knickpoints.

hypotheses.name: Antiparallel Gravity-Basement Step Concordance x Hydrothermal Disequilibrium Upflow
hypotheses.mechanism: Targets buried intrabasin and piedmont step-over faults where isostatic gravity drops into the basin antiparallel to increasing basement depth (-grad g_iso . grad Z_base > 0), co-located with hyperbolic basement/gravity relay-ramp saddles and DOE GDR 1391 chemical geothermometry disequilibrium / 2 m thermal probe plumes.

hypotheses.name: Kernel-Convolved Lagrangian-Priced Dinkelbach Submodular Cover (LDSA)
layers: Informative prior raster 3-px halo capacity index
hypotheses.mechanism: Pre-screens candidate dot centers by their 29-pixel 300 m triangular kernel integral rather than single-pixel point probability, and prices binding prior-raster 3-px halos via a convex utilization shadow price plus hard cap (<= 0.65) so dots shift 1-2 px into halo-free saddle positions (> 3.0 px from prior dot centers, < 3.0 px from fault traces) without losing DTI recall.
